loss_scaling_check.definition: identity forward map, coordinate-mean squared loss, SGD lr=1

embedding_distance_check.qualification: matrix-vector form still reads the full table; it avoids its V-by-d difference temporary and clone, not its FLOPs or bandwidth

local_geometry_check.definition: deliberately anisotropic two-dimensional linear counterexample, not language-model evidence

discrete_surrogate_check.definition: first-order discrete loss surrogate plus quadratic distance penalty
discrete_surrogate_check.qualification: same surrogate ranking in exact arithmetic; not a guarantee the nonlinear real loss follows that ranking

cached_gradient_check.definition: synthetic two-block causal attention prefix, fixed weights, float64, no rotary or grouped-query attention
cached_gradient_check.qualification: does not validate Agent 4 or Llama cache/rotary/precision integration

mismatch_check.definition: two-token public identity map with small target discrepancy
mismatch_check.qualification: rejecting a strict equality match does not justify discarding the best token under mismatch
